r100_move_decision.decision: do NOT move R100 mid-experiment; gcp2 matched pair continues to 100k in fp32
reasons: matched design: R8 is already training fp32 on gcp2 and the protocol requires chunk size to be the only candidate difference; a bf16 R100 vs fp32 R8 confounds precision, and AGENTS forbids pooling bf16 with fp32 results

no resume support: act18_train.py saves only step-10k/50k/100k checkpoints (no optimizer/scheduler/RNG state), so moving at 42,400/100,000 restarts from 0 and discards 13,484 s of completed training; a fresh bf16 100k run (~100k x 0.152 s = 4.2 h) would beat gcp2's remaining 57,600 x 0.318 s (~5.1 h) by only ~0.9 h while producing a second, redundant R100
gcp5 budget: gcp5 net-cost stop budget is 1,000 KRW (only gcp2 was raised to 2,000 KRW); a 4.2 h L4 run risks a mid-training budget stop, and there is no resume
r100_move_decision.bf16_adoption: per the AGENTS 10/17 rule, bf16_autocast_v1 is the precision for the next new training rounds; the in-flight matched R8/R100 pair stays fp32
r100_move_decision.gcp5_action: probe lease removed by the probe process; VM stopped after verifying GPU 0%, no act18 processes, no leases
